newsitem.title: USA: FBI executes search warrants on JB Oxford.
newsitem.headline: FBI executes search warrants on JB Oxford.

text.p: The Federal Bureau of Investigation raided Beverly Hills, Calif.-based discount broker JB Oxford Holdings Inc. Tuesday with a search warrant issued in connection with an undisclosed investigation.
Company officials declined to comment and the firm's legal counsel was not available, but a spokeswoman said the company would issue a statement later Tuesday.
FBI spokesman John Hoos said several agents went to the company early Tuesday with a warrant related to a white collar crime investigation but declined to elaborate.
Shares of JB Oxford closed at $1.34 a share, down 22 cents, on Nasdaq.
